See 'week 1' folder for preparation week code, exploring data, playing with functions + reading in flux files.
Going to add in read_flux function with extra column specifying site, country code and country pulling information from the file name, then read in some flux files.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

#This reads the CSV file into a data frame called df, df now contains all columns from the CSV

read_fluxdata <- function(fname) {
  df <- read.csv(fname)
  
  #extracts file name and adds it to a column
  site <- gsub(".csv", "", basename(fname))
  df$site <- site

  #convert TIMESTAMP_START to datetime and set as index
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(date = ymd_hm(TIMESTAMP)) %>%
    relocate(date)
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      year = year(date),
      doy = yday(date),
      hod = hour(date)
    )
  
  #Renaming a few things
  df <- df %>%
    rename(
      GPP = GPP_NT_VUT_REF,
      Qle = LE_F_MDS,
      Short_rad = SW_IN_F_MDS,
      VPD = VPD_F_MDS,
      TEMP = TA_F_MDS
    )
  
  vars_to_keep <- c("GPP", "Qle", "TEMP", "Short_rad", "VPD")
  df <- df %>% select(date, all_of(vars_to_keep), year, doy, hod)
  
  return(df)
  
}

```

Using the function to load in csv file of AU-Tum, Tumbarumba. Evergreen broadleaf forests, Australia.

```{r}
Tum_data <- read_fluxdata("/Users/alicerolfe/year_4_project/fluxnet_project/FLUXDATAKIT/FLX_AU-Tum_FLUXDATAKIT_FULLSET_DD_2002_2017_2-3.csv")

```
